name: Tricia
source:
The seventh angel. She is actually older than she looks, and she makes remarks that are unimaginably mature from his childhood appearance. The "curse" that was applied at an early age has stopped the growth of the body. Called a child prodigy since childhood, she always works for his surroundings rather than herself. 

[from Getchu]
